baseline.title: Convex hull
baseline.description: The smallest convex set containing a given set of points.

baseline.title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for complex inner-product spaces
baseline.description: In a complex inner-product space, |⟨u,v⟩|²≤⟨u,u⟩⟨v,v⟩ for all u,v.

method: Read current concept paragraphs/revisions and existing/pilot reviews, independently inspected selected committed source definitions, representative proof bodies and adjacent excluded candidates; checked exact dependency blobs with git show. decisions.statement_check: convexHull at Hull.lean:48 is the closure of Convex; subset_convexHull:52, convex_convexHull:55 and convexHull_min:66 establish exactly the smallest convex superset. Semiring/module generality specializes to real vector spaces. Finite affine/center-mass membership descriptions in Combination:256,309,345,381 have the required nonnegative weights and weight sum one. Join:174/179 gives ordinary union/insertion formulas under the stated nonempty assumptions.

Retain exclusion of Caratheodory, compactness, extreme points and geometric applications as separate endpoints.

decisions.statement_check: Defs:319–374 proves general complex/RCLike CS by nonnegative quadratic discriminant. Basic:280–282 exposes it. norm_inner_symm:226 identifies the product of two scalar norms with the modulus square. inner_self_nonneg:202 and inner_self_ofReal_re:207 show both diagonal inner products are nonnegative real scalars; under that conventional identification the catalogue inequality is exact. Inner-product conjugate-linearity convention does not change the modulus inequality. No finite-dimensionality or completeness assumption is needed.

decisions.file_decision: Searched native theorem/declaration names and usages of Cauchy/Schwarz, cauchy_schwarz, inner_mul_inner_self_le, norm_inner_le_norm, norm_inner_eq_norm and equality variants; inspected Young, Contraction, OpNormDefect, QuadraticForm/TwoVector and Gram/Pair candidates.
